body.question: Which industries must close under the Air Act when directed?

response.answer:
Compliance monitoring under the Air Act, 1981,
combined with closure directions for non-compliant units, was central to the
outcome. [1] Mandated switching of industries in the NCR from coal and pet-coke to piped
natural gas (PNG) reduced sulphur dioxide and particulate emissions from the
affected industrial clusters. [1] Non-compliant sites are liable for environmental
compensation and closure directions under the Air Act, 1981 and the
Environment (Protection) Act, 1986. [2] The Board may, in the exercise of its powers and performance of its functions
under this Act, issue any directions in writing to any person, officer, or
authority, including the power to direct the closure, prohibition, or
regulation of any industry, operation, or process; or the stoppage or
regulation of supply of electricity, water, or any other service. [3]
